Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_025118.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_025118.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_025118 (
    pdec0,
    pdec3,
    pdec12,
    pdec15,
    nando,
    addr
);
  output pdec0, pdec3, pdec12, pdec15;
  output [3:0] nando;  //the output of the 4 nand gates that you should be using

  input [5:0] addr;

  //
  // vvv - Declare your wires here - vvv
  //
  wire a = addr[5];
  wire b = addr[4];
  wire c = addr[3];
  wire d = addr[2];
  wire notA;
  wire notB;
  wire notC;
  wire notD;
  wire ABnd;
  wire CDnd;
  wire ABd;
  wire CDd;

  //
  // vvv - Your structural verilog code here - vvv
  //
  inv ay (
      notA,
      a
  );
  inv be (
      notB,
      b
  );
  inv se (
      notC,
      c
  );
  inv di (
      notD,
      d
  );

  nand2 une (
      ABnd,
      notA,
      notB
  );
  nand2 too (
      CDnd,
      notC,
      notD
  );
  nand2 tre (
      ABd,
      a,
      b
  );
  nand2 fer (
      CDd,
      c,
      d
  );

  nor2 un (
      pdec0,
      ABnd,
      CDnd
  );  //pdec[0]
  nor2 to (
      pdec3,
      ABnd,
      CDd
  );  //pdec[3]
  nor2 te (
      pdec12,
      ABd,
      CDnd
  );  //pdec[12]
  nor2 fr (
      pdec15,
      ABd,
      CDd
  );  //pdec[15]

  assign nando[0] = ABnd;
  assign nando[1] = CDnd;
  assign nando[2] = ABd;
  assign nando[3] = CDd;
endmodule
